plain_language_explanation.summary_title: Debris Slide Impacting Residential Dwelling in Mandi
plain_language_explanation.what_happened: A saturated soil mass collapsed from the steep slope directly behind a rural house, breaching the rear wall and burying part of the structure under mud and debris.
plain_language_explanation.why_it_happened: Continuous heavy rainfall saturated the clayey soil and loose colluvium on the steep cut slope, increasing pore water pressure and drastically reducing soil shear strength until failure occurred.
plain_language_explanation.property_and_access_impact: The residential dwelling has sustained direct structural impact with debris entering living quarters, making the building temporarily uninhabitable.
plain_language_explanation.road_and_travel_impact: Passage is obstructed (2.50 m (Single-Lane Restricted / Shoulder Lost)). Vehicles and pedestrians cannot safely transit this point.
plain_language_explanation.ongoing_hazards: High risk of secondary slump failures from the unstable head scarp during continued rainfall, along with electrical hazards from compromised domestic wiring.
plain_language_explanation.what_needs_to_be_done: Evacuate the structure immediately, perform manual and light mechanical debris removal, and construct a heavy-duty retaining breast wall with proper drainage.
plain_language_explanation.citizen_safety_advice: Do not re-enter the damaged building or approach the base of the open earth scarp until geotechnical clearance is officially granted.

plain_language_explanation.why_it_happened: Heavy rainfall soaked deep into the mountain slope, lubricating natural slip planes until the slope gave way.
